name: good-auto-meets
description: Agent-operated local capture and reports for scheduled online lectures and meetings.

interface.shortDescription: Record lectures and meetings locally with an agent.
interface.longDescription: An agent reads your calendar, joins authorized meetings, records audio and selected frames, transcribes locally, and prepares a sourced HTML report. Windows capture requires first-run setup and a live test.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Good Auto Meets. Here is my schedule: <link>.
